description: Models inter-district graph proximity and crime spillover across 850 nodes.
Captures 3-year sequential temporal momentum and multi-year crime trends.
Extracts multi-category spatial feature patterns from 33 crime dimensions.
Fuses 64-dim spatial CNN with 32-dim temporal LSTM representations (96-dim).
Proposed tri-modal architecture uniting spatial, temporal, and graph topological branches (128-dim).
